inputs.prompt:
Create ONE isolated physical inventory icon for Joseon Hunters, a Korean dark-fantasy ARPG whose item icons share Diablo II Resurrected's readable tangible painted-object feel. One single jade stone, compact upright OVAL CABOCHON family with a slightly arched face, thickness visible along one side in a modest three-quarter view. Traditional jade with broad polished stone planes, restrained realistic highlights, bold dark outline, meticulous painterly texture, believable slightly waxy translucent depth. This is a socketable raw/polished jade object, not jewelry: NO cord, necklace, setting, pendant hole, metal fittings, runes, person, hand or stand. It must remain recognizable at 40 pixels and grayscale. The whole isolated oval stone occupies 78-84 percent of square height, centered with clear margins, on transparent background. No shadow or aura surrounding the stone, no backdrop, text, labels, numbers, UI frames, decorative borders, magical effects, sparkles or particles. Readable wide material highlight and naturally lit edge rather than emissive glow. Keep color saturation restrained for a Korean dark-fantasy inventory. Color and grade requirements follow; do not invent an equipment tier label.
COLOR: Deep cinnabar-red jade with subtle dark red-brown mineral clouds, restrained warm ivory edge reflections.
GRADE 2 FLAWED: same upright oval jade family, almost complete stone but one clearly visible diagonal crack and two small edge nicks. Partially smoothed face, cloudy inclusion band and modest broader sheen. Less broken and more valuable than chipped, still clearly imperfect.
